Heard.
The correction application is allowed.
Necessary correction has been incorporated in the order dated 07.07.2023.

The correct order shall read as under:
"By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.103 of 2022 at Police Station-Chhatari, District-Bulandshahar under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 304-B IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the D.P. Act.
The applicant is in jail since 14.04.2022.

sentences.text: The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the trial court on 07.11.2022.

The following arguments made by Ms. Sufia Saba, learned counsel holding brief of Shri Pankaj Kumar Tyagi, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Mukesh Kushwaha, learned counsel for the informant and Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned A.G.A.-I for the State from the record,
entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
2. The applicant never harassed the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
The applicant is bereaved by the death of his wife.
3. It is submitted that the deceased was a temperamental lady who was prone to extreme reactions even over trivial issues.
4. On the fateful day, in a fit of rage she committed suicide by hanging after a minor disagreement with the members of the household.

5. The post mortem report opines that:
(i) The cause of death is asphyxia due to antemortem hanging.
(ii) Hyoid bone was found to be intact.
(iii) Other injuries including ligature marks are consistent with the hanging.
6. No antemortem injury reflecting the forceful assault is depicted in the post mortem report.
7. The applicant did not abet or instigate the victim to commit suicide.
8. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
9. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Rahul Kumar be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.
The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
